text_block_list.text:
I brought Mejiro Ramonu to the infirmary 
after she got injured during training.

Mejiro Ramonu checks the affected area 
with her own hands. Her expression remains 
calm, without a trace of agitation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—The symptoms are mild. Yes... it's 
nothing serious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...You worry too much. Or do you doubt my 
judgment?
choice_data_list:
It's my job to prepare for any 
contingency.

It's my job to prepare for any 
contingency.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Heh... Very well. That is fine.

True to her assessment, there don't appear 
to be any issues. As for whether I should 
allow her to continue training, my 
thoughts are—
choice_data_list: Let's play it safe and take the day off.

If we resume practice, let's take it 
carefully.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...That is my view as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"If I am to offer anything, it must be the 
supreme love... Our secret rendezvous must 
be put on hold for a while."

Mejiro Ramonu turned her gaze out the 
window and spoke those words to her 
beloved.

Afterward, Mejiro Ramonu returned to the 
grounds and resumed her training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Let's head back. Rushing impatiently 
will gain us nothing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
My love is something to offer— not 
something to drown ungracefully in...

It seemed that Mejiro Ramonu had 
aggravated her injury.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: Are you able to run without any issues?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yes... A minor injury like this will never 
shake my love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Just wait... I'll prove it right now—

Without sparing me a glance, Mejiro Ramonu 
ran out onto the turf, looking as 
beautiful as ever.
